lines.say: Does muscle turn into fat when you stop training?
Muscle and fat are two completely different tissues. One can't turn into the other, like an apple can't turn into an orange.
What really happens: you stop training, and your muscles slowly shrink.
And if you keep eating like before, while burning less, fat goes up.
Muscle shrinking plus fat growing looks like muscle turning into fat. It isn't.
Verdict: myth. And good news: muscle comes back faster the second time, thanks to muscle memory.
Taking a break? Keep your protein up, eat a bit less, and stay active.
